recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Pizza Toast with Hot Honey
steps: Preheat the oven or air fryer to 375°F.
Spread about 2 tbsp sauce on each slice, then the cottage cheese, then the torn mozzarella.
Bake 12 minutes until the mozzarella melts and the edges are golden and crisp.
Top with oregano and drizzle with hot honey.
recipes.notes: Ingredients, steps and calories are the creator's; she only lists calories, so protein, carbs and fat are my estimate. Add pepperoni or cooked chicken for more protein.
